chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salama ibn al-Khattab, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqteen, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Yahya, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) married Umm Salama. Umar ibn Abi Salama married her to him, and he was young and had not yet attained puberty.
ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the age and marital status of the Prophet Muhammad when he married Umm Salama?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* clarifies the marital status of Umm Salama by noting that her husband, Umar ibn Abi Salama, was still a minor (*ghulam*) who had not yet reached puberty (*bulugh*) at the time of the Prophet's marriage to her. This detail is significant in Shia and Sunni scholarship for understanding the timeline of the Prophet's marriages and the specific circumstances of Umm Salama's transition from her first husband to the Prophet, emphasizing the validity of the marriage despite the young age of her previous spouse.
